consensus_strengths: The strongest recorder-relative contribution is a self-contained finite-domain identity-lock/period-selector formulation, with internally checkable printed schedule arithmetic and explicitly bounded interpretation.

Reviews consistently credit the separation of two main arms, the reused L32 development control, incomplete L24/L48 probes, and separate-bed analyses; they also credit the explicit rejection of causal, mechanism, calibrated-inference, and universality claims.
consensus_weaknesses: The central three-profile empirical result, resampling summaries, and measurement semantics are reported as not locally reproducible; supplied reviews support only arithmetic consistency of printed values, not empirical validation.
The current empirical significance is narrow: a composite partition-plus-allocation comparison on two main arms with a reused development control, not independent confirmation.
Evidence strata and bed labels are dense enough that non-headline probes and separate-bed analyses may be mistaken for corroboration.

positions: Reproducibility review treats the absence of replayable artifacts as a critical reproducibility failure and assigns a ceiling of 2.
Other reviews treat the empirical observations as cannot_verify rather than demonstrated false, while retaining a ceiling of 4 for the narrowly framed formal/reporting contribution.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not infer empirical falsity. Score the present paper for its independently checkable formal/accounting contribution only; an artifact replay is required before empirical results can support acceptance.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether new controls are required for the scoped claim
positions: Experimental and novelty reviews request a fresh matched L32 control and/or dual-recorder or factorial experiments.
Other reviews find the existing language already limits the result to a recorder-relative composite association and do not establish that these experiments are prerequisites for that narrow claim.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Require a fresh L32 control for stronger comparative empirical claims; require dual-recorder/factorial evidence only before recorder-causal, allocation-component, or broader diagnostic claims.

positions: Technical review alleges that a Table 6 L=64 synthetic row selects an off-grid period.
No other supplied review independently substantiates that allegation, and the allowed materials do not expose the table itself for adjudication.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Treat it as unresolved but unsupported in this meta-review; verify the displayed grid and selector output against the frozen manuscript/source before elevating it to a technical defect.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The claimed Table 6 contradiction cannot be checked from the permitted manifest, rubric, schema, and review JSONs; it is a single-review allegation rather than demonstrated error in the supplied meta-review evidence.
The assertion that the closest-work boundary omits direct antecedents is not established by the supplied materials; the reviews acknowledge that no literature search was performed.

prioritized_actions.description: Add one early evidence/bed map and consistently label main arms, reused L32/NFE48 development control, unauditable L24/L48 probes, and separate L32/NFE32 analyses; demote non-load-bearing analyses from headline support.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A reader can identify the sole headline claim, evidence tier, and status of every arm without cross-referencing prose.

prioritized_actions.description: Release a reviewer-safe replay bundle for the three headline profiles: event/sufficient-statistic data, event/time semantics, deterministic analysis, configurations, candidate outputs, and bootstrap/pairing records.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean independent replay regenerates the reported selector rows and clearly separates source reproduction from arithmetic checks.

prioritized_actions.description: Run a fresh matched L32/NFE48 control with immutable input and pairing manifests before presenting the three profiles as comparative empirical evidence.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The fresh control is replayable and protocol-matched to main arms; arm-wise and paired results are reported separately.

prioritized_actions.description: Complete a source-supported citation and closest-work audit, or narrow positioning statements to the currently verified comparison scope.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Each factual/comparative citation has verified metadata and local support, with no unsupported novelty claim.

must_resolve_before_accept: Replayable evidence and semantic specification for any retained central empirical claim.
A fresh matched L32 control if the empirical comparison remains a central contribution.
Clear evidence-tier and bed-status presentation preventing probes or separate-bed analyses from functioning as confirmation.
Verification of the alleged Table 6 inconsistency before relying on that synthetic control.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not convert source-reported arithmetic consistency into claims of reproduced empirical validation.
Do not present the reused development control, incomplete probes, rank-sum sensitivity, spectral analysis, or separate content bed as independent confirmation.
Do not strengthen mechanism, recorder-causal, allocation-causal, novelty, or universality language without the corresponding evidence.
decision_rationale: The present record supports a careful, recorder-relative formal/reporting contribution, but not independently auditable empirical knowledge. The consistent limitation warrants marginally below threshold; the inability to verify is not evidence that the reported phenomenon is false, so the ceiling remains 4 rather than 2.
